units.source_text: 先生的心情很好，而夫人似乎更兴奋。

en.t: Sensei was in very good spirits, and his wife seemed even more excited.

units.source_text: 刚刚夫人那漂亮的眼睛中还闪烁着泪花，漆黑的眉头还紧蹙着呢。

en.t: Only moments before, tears had still been glimmering in her beautiful eyes, and her dark brows had still been drawn tightly together.

units.source_text: 我仔细地打量着夫人这一百八十度的变化，

en.t: I studied this complete change in her carefully,

units.source_text: 如果不是做戏的话（实际上我并不认为这是做戏），

en.t: and if it was not an act (in fact, I did not think it was),

units.source_text: 那么刚才夫人对我的倾诉，就只能让人理解为是女人为了玩弄感伤，佯装出来的无聊之举。

en.t: then what she had just poured out to me could only be understood as a pointless performance, put on by a woman merely to toy with sentiment.

units.source_text: 不过，当时我并没有想要责怪夫人，

en.t: Still, at the time I had no wish to blame her,

units.source_text: 我看到夫人的神色突然变得如此兴奋，反倒放心了。

en.t: and seeing her expression suddenly become so animated actually put me at ease.

units.source_text: 真是如此，我也就无须那么担忧了。

en.t: If that was how things stood, I no longer needed to worry so much.

units.source_text: 先生笑着问我：“让你受累了，小偷没来吧？”

en.t: Sensei asked me with a smile, "Thank you for all your trouble. The thief did not come, did he?"

units.source_text: 接着又打趣道：“小偷没来，你很扫兴吧？”

en.t: Then he added jokingly, "You must be disappointed that the thief never showed up."

units.source_text: 我要回去时，夫人对我说：“真是对不起。”

en.t: When I was about to leave, his wife said to me, "I am terribly sorry."

units.source_text: 这句话的口气颇有些调侃的味道，听起来像是在说，浪费了我的宝贵时间很抱歉，

en.t: There was a rather teasing tone in her words; it sounded as though she were apologizing for wasting my precious time,

units.source_text: 但更像是对我专程来蹲守却没碰上小偷而表示遗憾似的。

en.t: but even more as though she regretted that I had come all the way to keep watch and had not had the chance to meet the thief.

units.source_text: 她一边说，一边用纸包上刚才吃剩的点心，塞在我手里。

en.t: As she spoke, she wrapped the leftover sweets from earlier in paper and pressed them into my hand.

units.source_text: 我把点心装进和服袖子里，告辞出去，

en.t: I slipped the sweets into the sleeve of my kimono, took my leave, and went out,

units.source_text: 快步穿过夜深天寒、行人稀少的弯曲小路，朝热闹的大街走去。

en.t: then hurried through the winding, sparsely traveled lanes of the cold late night toward the lively main street.
